title: Zadar celebrate U17 National title
description: Zadar U17 - Cibona U17 89-80 Zadar celebrated U17 National title beating Cibona 89-80. Trailing 4 points at the end of the first quarter, Zadar posted a 32-21 surge in the second frame. Moreover, they closed the campaign with a 22-14 rally to seal the win. Luka Bicic (177-PG-2007) was unstoppable with 38 points for the winners, whilst Toni Josipovic (191-G-2007) netted 23. Bruno Bubalo (198-PG-2007) and Borna Katanovic (197-SF-2007) replied with 26 points each in the losing effort.
